whyThisDate: Your rent is 45% of income, which qualifies as need.
A $1,900 collection is the first thing to clear, so every extra dollar goes there first.
Credit that needs work takes about a year of clean history after debts are under control.
You need $7,100 for down payment and closing, and your savings plan gets you there.

actions.title: Call the collection agency this week
actions.detail: Ask for a pay-for-delete agreement in writing before you pay.

actions.title: Book a free credit coaching session
actions.detail: A SparkPoint OC coach helps you order your debts and set up on-time payments.

actions.title: Set up an automatic savings transfer
actions.detail: Move money the day you get paid toward your $7,100 goal.

actions.title: Sign up for a Habitat OC orientation
actions.detail: You can attend before you're fully ready.

actions.title: Start a folder of pay stubs and bank statements
actions.detail: Keep the last two months of each.
